the Specstride reference tree at 9cab15d in scratch (ORACLE_REF_SPECSTRIDE)

referenceEdits.why: the scenario is a pass whose harness is NOT installed, and `dsh` is a stub executable of §O.3 that stands on the search path of every run, so the condition cannot be reached by leaving it out. The as-is variable that names the DSH executable (`SPECSTRIDE_DSH_BIN`) stands in the environment alias table of feature 100, annex X §X.8 in PROSE only ('The as-is variable for the executable of a harness, and for its profile'), so `hermeticEnvironment` cannot declare it the way `FX-18/harness-missing-prime` declares `SPECSTRIDE_PRIME_AGENT_BIN`. The edit moves the DEFAULT of that variable to a name no directory of the search path holds; the line under test (`proposer.sh:549`, `command -v` and `return 127`) is untouched. The port reaches the same state through `harnesses.dsh.bin` and takes no edit.
